name: cfn-sim-deploy
description: Throwaway engine test: deploy-workshop.sh tier 1/2/3 in CodeBuild (issue #46 spike)

source.buildspec:
version: 0.2
env:
  parameter-store:
    ACME_EMAIL: /cfn-sim/acme_email
    ICR_ENTITLEMENT_KEY: /cfn-sim/icr_entitlement_key
    IVIA_MMFA_PUSH_CLIENT_SECRET: /cfn-sim/ivia_mmfa_push_client_secret
phases:
  install:
    commands:
      - set -e
      - export HOME=/root
      - echo "=== installing tools (terraform, kubectl, helm, yq, bc) ==="
      - TF_VERSION=1.10.5
      - curl -fsSL -o /tmp/tf.zip https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/${TF_VERSION}/terraform_${TF_VERSION}_linux_amd64.zip && unzip -o /tmp/tf.zip -d /usr/local/bin >/dev/null && terraform version | head -1
      - curl -fsSL -o /usr/local/bin/kubectl https://dl.k8s.io/release/v1.34.0/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/kubectl && kubectl version --client | head -1
      - curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash >/dev/null 2>&1 && helm version --short
      - curl -fsSL -o /usr/local/bin/yq https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/latest/download/yq_linux_amd64 && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq && yq --version
      - command -v bc >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -y >/dev/null && apt-get install -y bc >/dev/null)
      - command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -y >/dev/null && apt-get install -y jq >/dev/null)
      - jq --version
  pre_build:
    commands:
      - set -e
      - cd "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR"
      - export HOME=/root
      - echo "=== bootstrap (seed tfvars from .example + terraform init all roots) ==="
      - bash infrastructure/scripts/bootstrap.sh --skip-prereq-gate
      - echo "=== inject 3 secrets from SSM into tfvars ==="
      - sed -i "s|^acme_email = .*|acme_email = \"${ACME_EMAIL}\"|" infrastructure/terraform.tfvars
      - sed -i "s|^icr_entitlement_key = .*|icr_entitlement_key = \"${ICR_ENTITLEMENT_KEY}\"|" infrastructure/services/terraform.tfvars
      - sed -i "s|^ivia_mmfa_push_client_secret = .*|ivia_mmfa_push_client_secret = \"${IVIA_MMFA_PUSH_CLIENT_SECRET}\"|" infrastructure/services/terraform.tfvars
      - echo "acme set:" $(grep -c '^acme_email = ".\+"' infrastructure/terraform.tfvars) "| icr set:" $(grep -c '^icr_entitlement_key = ".\+"' infrastructure/services/terraform.tfvars) "| mmfa set:" $(grep -c '^ivia_mmfa_push_client_secret = ".\+"' infrastructure/services/terraform.tfvars)
  build:
    commands:
      - |
        cd "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR"; export HOME=/root
        SCR=infrastructure/scripts
        run_tier(){ local n=$1 t0 t1 rc; echo "##################### TIER $n START $(date -u +%FT%TZ) #####################"; t0=$(date +%s); bash $SCR/deploy-workshop.sh --tier "$n"; rc=$?; t1=$(date +%s); echo "##################### TIER $n END rc=$rc dur=$(((t1-t0)/60))m$(((t1-t0)%60))s #####################"; return $rc; }
        gate(){ echo "===== VERIFY: $* ====="; bash "$@"; }
        OVERALL=0
        run_tier 1 || OVERALL=1
        [ $OVERALL -eq 0 ] && { gate $SCR/test-foundation.sh || { echo "FOUNDATION VERIFY FAILED"; OVERALL=1; }; }
        [ $OVERALL -ne 0 ] && { echo ">>> STOP after tier-1/foundation — not proceeding"; exit 1; }
        run_tier 2 || OVERALL=1
        [ $OVERALL -eq 0 ] && { gate $SCR/test-vault-verify.sh || { echo "VAULT VERIFY FAILED"; OVERALL=1; }; }
        [ $OVERALL -ne 0 ] && { echo ">>> STOP after tier-2/vault — possible known IVIA/ACME flake (NOT a bridge failure)"; exit 1; }
        run_tier 3 || OVERALL=1
        [ $OVERALL -eq 0 ] && { gate $SCR/verify-uc1.sh || { echo "UC1 VERIFY FAILED"; OVERALL=1; }; }
        [ $OVERALL -eq 0 ] && { echo "===== VERIFY: verify-uc3.sh --bypass ====="; bash $SCR/verify-uc3.sh --bypass || { echo "UC3 BYPASS VERIFY FAILED"; OVERALL=1; }; }
        echo "NOTE: verify-uc2.sh + verify-uc3 happy-path need a live WebSEAL browser login (per script headers) — event-day exercises, not gated here."
        echo "##################### ENGINE RESULT: OVERALL=$OVERALL #####################"
        exit $OVERALL
